summary: The manuscript reports a fully preregistered paired confirmatory experiment under shared_initial_candidate semantics that found no validator-detected faults (200/200 valid in both arms), correctly documents preregistration and execution artifacts, states the estimand limits imposed by shared_initial_candidate sampling, and archives the evidence needed for audit. No critical defects remain; the paper should be accepted for finalisation after optional clarifications.
optional_revisions: Optionally add a very short paragraph (Methods or Limitations) naming specific task-generator parameters or manifest examples (e.g., difficulty-level tags, required_sequence length) that correlated with the all-valid outcomes so future preregistered runs can target adversarial or higher-fault tasks.

Optionally include a short parenthetical in Methods pointing readers to the archived model_configuration.json path (execution/model_configuration.json) as a convenience reminder that temperature = null was recorded there.
